title.zh: 将达沃省马利塔市镇蒂库隆小学的名称变更为Toribio Limcaoco小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Ticulon Elementary School in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao, to Toribio Limcaoco Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Ticulon Elementary School in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao, to Toribio Limcaoco Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Ticulon tại Thị trấn Malita, Tỉnh Davao thành Trường tiểu học Toribio Limcaoco
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Ticulon ในเทศบาล Malita, จังหวัด Davao เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Toribio Limcaoco
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Ticulon di Kotamadya Malita, Provinsi Davao menjadi Sekolah Dasar Toribio Limcaoco
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Ticulon di Perbandaran Malita, Wilayah Davao menjadi Sekolah Rendah Toribio Limcaoco

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4404_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Ticulon Elementary School in the Municipality of Malita, Province of Davao, is hereby changed to Toribio Limcaoco Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
